stats.name: Brawn
stats.about: Strength, endurance, holding your breath against the cold.

stats.name: Grace
stats.about: Balance, quick hands, moving without a sound.

stats.name: Wits
stats.about: Noticing, reasoning, remembering the old city's ways.

stats.name: Nerve
stats.about: Courage, will, keeping your head when the lamps go out.

skills.name: Fight
skills.about: Hook, knife and fist, up close.

skills.name: Swim
skills.about: Moving fast or far in water, fighting a current.

skills.name: Sense
skills.about: Seeing what moves in dark water; hearing the glass.

skills.name: Lore
skills.about: The drowned city's guilds, songs and traps.

skills.name: Talk
skills.about: Bargain, bluff, calm a frightened friend.

ladder.name: Deep
ladder.about: Hard: the best on the dock.

ladder.name: Abyssal
ladder.about: Extreme: a story told for years.

snag.effect: Each Crack (a 1) marks 1 Strain, even on a success.

table.name: Slip
table.effect: Drop something, lose your footing, or make a noise.

table.name: Tangle
table.effect: You are Snared until you spend an action to cut free.

table.name: Blackout
table.effect: The water closes in: lose 1d6 Breath.

surge.effect: A Gleam (two 6s and no 1s): on an attack the weapon counts twice. On any other roll, choose one bonus.
options: Do it in half the time.
Learn one true thing about this place.
An ally gains +2 dice on their next roll.

strain.name: Strain
strain.atMax: Breakdown: you are Shaken until you rest, and your Strain drops to 3.

actions.name: Move
actions.does: Swim or climb to somewhere close.

actions.name: Brace
actions.does: +2 to your defence until your next turn.

actions.name: Steady
actions.does: Clear 1 Strain, or help a friend clear Shaken (Standard Nerve + Talk).

actions.name: Use
actions.does: Use an ability, a lamp or a tool.

conditions.name: Shaken
conditions.ends: A rest, or a friend's Steady action.

conditions.name: Snared
conditions.ends: Spend an action to cut free.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.effect: Lose 1 Breath at the start of each of your turns.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.effect: -2 dice on anything that needs sight.
conditions.ends: Light, or the end of the scene.

rest.short: A few minutes on a ledge with air: recover half your Breath and clear 2 Strain. The Tide ticks once.
rest.long: A night on the dock: recover all Breath, clear all Strain and all conditions.

advancement.perLevel: Each Dive rank: +2 Breath and +1 skill rank (max 3). Every third rank: +1 to a stat (max 5).

rulings.a: One rolls. Each helper adds 1 die, at most +2, and shares any Cracks.
You are drowning: you can only cling and hope. A friend can haul you up with a Standard Brawn + Swim roll.
